calls.reconciliation: Factual dispute: size of the Q3 SpaceX mark-to-market loss. Run 2 assumed a 30-40% decline, which made GAAP about -0.08. Run 3's share-based math is internally consistent: 18.99M shares, an implied ~$158 at Jun 30 from the $1.005B gain on $2B cost, and $150.86 at Sep 30, so about -$135M. Run 2's own note that SpaceX was ~7% below its IPO close on Sep 30 matches it. I adopted Run 3's figure, putting GAAP ~0.15 rather than negative. That removes the case for Run 2's fat lower tail and makes declaring mass below the lower bound unnecessary. Judgment calls: GAAP weight, where I take 80/20 non-GAAP because consensus and data feeds use adjusted EPS for Tesla; and the non-GAAP centre, where I put ~0.38, below consensus, given the Q2 miss and flat QoQ fundamentals. My reference class is a variant of the runs'.
